module_title: Web Browsers, Search Engines, and Email - Foundational Basics
introduction: In SSC and Banking exams, everyday Internet usage is a highly tested domain. At this foundational level, we will differentiate between the fundamental tools used to navigate the internet—Web Browsers and Search Engines—and understand the basic architecture of Electronic Mail (Email).

core_concepts.title: Web Browser
core_concepts.description:
A Web Browser is an 'Application Software' installed on your computer or mobile device. Its primary job is to fetch and display websites on your screen. 
Examples: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge.

core_concepts.title: Search Engine
core_concepts.description:
A Search Engine is a 'Website' or an online tool that searches through billions of pages on the internet to find information related to the specific keywords you typed. 
Examples: Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo.

core_concepts.title: Email (Electronic Mail)
core_concepts.description: The process of sending and receiving digital messages over the internet. To successfully send an email, both the sender and the receiver must possess a valid, unique 'Email Address'.

core_concepts.title: CC and BCC (Core Email Components)
core_concepts.description:
- CC (Carbon Copy): Used when you want to send an email to secondary recipients, and you want EVERYONE to see who else received the email.
- BCC (Blind Carbon Copy): Used when sending an email to multiple people, but you want to keep everyone's email address 'hidden' from each other for privacy.

important_entities.name: URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
important_entities.significance: The unique global address of a specific webpage on the internet (e.g., https://www.google.com). This is exactly what you type into the 'Address Bar' at the top of a web browser.

important_entities.name: Home Page
important_entities.significance: The very first introductory or main page of a website that appears when you type in a domain name (like amazon.in).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: This is the most common beginner mistake! 'Google Chrome' is a Web Browser (a software app on your PC), whereas 'Google' is a Search Engine (a website). Similarly, 'Microsoft Edge' is a browser, while 'Bing' is a search engine. Never mix them up.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Remember that the list of people in the BCC field is completely 'Blind' (invisible) to all other recipients of the email.

exam_strategy_tips: In SSC CGL Tier-1, the full forms of CC and BCC are heavily tested. Memorize them perfectly. Additionally, examiners frequently ask about 'DuckDuckGo'—always classify it as a 'Search Engine'.
